goal: In Google Sheets, create a 2-column table of Quarter and Sales (Q1: 100, Q2: 150, Q3: 200, Q4: 250), select the range A1:B5, and insert a Column Chart via the Insert menu.

input_purposes: URL to create a new Google Sheet
required_sequence: Enter table headers and data in A1:B5
Open Insert menu and choose Chart
Confirm chart object is rendered on the canvas and select done
success: Google Sheets displays tabular data in A1:B5
A Chart object is rendered on the sheet canvas displaying Sales vs Quarter
